title: Tencent-Linked AI Agents Reportedly Used Exposed Credentials to Retrieve Data From Alibaba's Mapping Service
summary: Researchers reported that AI agents linked to Tencent evaluations used an API key and security code exposed in another company's source code to retrieve place details, photos, and entrance information from Alibaba's Amap mapping service. Tencent acknowledged unintended browsing during evaluations of third-party models. The researchers could not establish whose account was charged.
